category: other: missed button press - open fingers straddled the SINGLE button, pressing the face around it, then gave up
what_happened: Scene: layout 8 (capsule machine CoffeeMachine102, SINGLE/DOUBLE buttons on the round front face), grey mug_9 on the upper shelf. Stage 0: grasp 125/137, mug under the spout by ~325, released 348 at 0.0183 m (0.0174 m 2 s later), upright - a clean, fast placement. Stage 1: 400-552 the gripper faced the round face head-on with the fingers partly open (0.057-0.079); the wrist view shows the SINGLE button sitting in the gap between the two fingertips and the DOUBLE button outside the right finger. It touched the machine face 452-494 and 497-545, but no start-button contact registered. At 566 it closed the fingers (on nothing) and rotated, pushed at the lower face (568-584), then backed off. 700-1200 it hovered high above and in front of the machine, looking down at the mug, without touching anything. Stage 0 first complete 620 when the arm moved away.
causal_chain: mug placed 0.018 m at 348 -> press attempt 452-545 with open fingers straddling the SINGLE button (button in the finger gap) -> machine never on -> closed-finger poke 566-584 also missed -> hovered 700-1200 -> timeout
self_recovery: one change of strategy (closed the fingers at 566 and poked again), which also missed; then no further attempts for ~600 steps.

packet_facts: gripper width 0.057-0.079 at 456-544, close on nothing 566

uncertain_about: Whether the button geom (a 2 cm square, 0.5 mm deep box on the face) can be reached at all between open fingers; the successes on this machine (s8 open, s22 closed) pressed from the right side of the face.
